source: Installed Google Chrome opening the actual offline standalone HTML over file://. It performs a real March and combat action; QA changes only the travel clock and seeds durable defender values so automatic mode remains observable. The timeout itself, turn processing, UI state and v07 Save/Reload use shipped runtime/UI code.

checks.name: Offline game opens with the requested Vietnamese title
A real March opens a save-valid tactical encounter
Battle UI displays the ten-second Sina timeout
Stand By skips only the selected stack for one round while the enemy acts
The selected stack attacks on its next commanded round after Stand By
Retreat moves the selected group backward without aborting the whole battle
Selecting a unit refreshes the manual-control grace period
Advance resolves an actual combat round and resets the timeout
v07 Save/Reload preserves the active battle and its timeout
No-input expiry switches the actual encounter into automatic mode
Automatic mode executes a real next turn
Player can re-enter manual control without ending the battle
No JavaScript exceptions during timeout, automatic turn and manual re-entry
